title: Jagged Dense Vietnamese Chicken Pho Ga
description: A bitter, dense, and indulgent Vietnamese dish featuring cornstarch and brine-wet chicken, this pho ga is a low-glycemic-friendly option for those looking for a hearty meal.
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken broth, fish sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch and a splash of the hot broth until smooth.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the sliced chicken breast to the pot and cook until cooked through.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
Assemble the pho ga by placing noodles in a bowl, adding sliced chicken, and ladling the hot broth over the top.
Garnish with bean sprouts and serve immediately.
